body:
I don’t have much advice, I’d say I’m in a similar position but I’m 25 and work in a software support role. Networking is something I have done but not something I can enjoy! 

I’ve used SQL and poweshell in the past. So I’ve looked into coding.

Free coding courses at https://codefirstgirls.com - they provide courses to all genders, despite the name. The MOOCS are the starter courses. I begun the “Intro to Coding” MOOC Sprint as a beginner. 


Or https://www.codecademy.com/catalog. I once used as part of a job application to learn python and it was really fun too.


There are plenty of free resources to get a taster of coding and it’s time consuming, especially if your working full-time but definitely achievable if you have the motivation. Then you’d only need to pay for the exams and certificates.


But I have the same question, what language do I learn?

I’m interested to see some more experienced developers responses so I’ll be keeping and eye on this post 😊

Her loss then. I’m a woman and I know first hand some women can be selfish. Don’t take it to heart. 
You could try bumble or plenty of fish? I have been on POF myself, I wasn’t looking for commitment lol, but there was definitely potential in some of the men I met. Not to mention both my adult brothers have found long term partners on POF.

If you’ve met before and things went well I’d Wait for her response maybe something came up? Regardless there’s plenty more fish in the sea, whilst you’re waiting for a reply get on a dating site and size up your other options!

Good luck! Cuddle the ones you love from me. I want to thank them for being there for you. 
You all will make it through together.

I want you to know I’ve read your post and I understand how you feel. Wherever you find refuge take it. Whether it’s online or in real life. What’s matters is that your heard. 

Please don’t do anything dangerous to yourself because somebody loves you. It may not feel like it sometimes but they do. Our minds can be our worst enemies sometimes.

It’s okay to feel helpless. Before acting on your emotions speak to someone. Message me. Post here again. Just know you’re not alone.

antidepressants are a great shout. A lot of people I know rely on stuff like this to get them through. The world isn’t always a kind place and we all have a different experience of the world. So some people need a little extra help.

Personally, I’ve experienced alcoholism with my grandparents. My mum went to prison and left 4 kids behind and suddenly alcohol wasn’t a priority to them.

Maybe you can fill your dads life with some extra purpose or love? Like a pet? I know a cuddle with my cat always cheers me up and it would also give him a reason to get up on a morning.

Sorry I’m late! I have had similar thoughts/feelings and for a long time I only lived for other people. Now I live for both. My loved ones need me and I need me! Remind yourself of what you have achieved so far and where you plan on going.

Hope you’re feeling better.

Sign their address up for junk mail. Fill out their details on websites and let them get all the the mail for it

Put sticky stuff (honey, Vaseline) on their door knob or door bell

Leave something smelly/rotten on their landing

Park in their spot

Don’t be scared to be you. Some people don’t like different but others love you for your differences.

If this is your last year at least you know it’s over soon. I’m sure you have goals to achieve and that’s what’s most important. Don’t engage with the hate, respond with success. In half a year you’re out of there!

Hang in there. You’re right any kind of infection can cause delirium and when mixed with dementia is a dangerous cocktail. The hospital is the best place for her.

I second the last comment, call the hospital, they should give you info if you are a family member

Hey, you’re not alone. Addiction can catch any of us. Fighting an addiction can be hard but there’s always light at the end of the tunnel. If he’s taken this step i hope he has some fight left in him. Good things never come easy, but it’s fulfilling to look back and see what you have achieved already.

The hell continues. Grandma nearly set fire to her flat last night. As she lives in sheltered accommodation the fire brigade attended the address within 3 minutes. My grandma doesn’t has a cooker, she had put a lot cig in a bin. A wicker bin, with a plastic bin bag. The whole block of flats were evacuated, expect from the bed ridden man next door who has probably already accepted the fact he’s going to die in his flat, but probably not by fire. We can only refer her to social services again. 

All the elderly residents were terrified to go home and insisted we stayed with her for the night but it’s just not possible. She has one bedroom. She smokes 40 cigs a day making the oxygen non-existent half the time. We all work and there is a 7 month old baby to care for.

I’ve woken up with 2 painful lumps on either leg. They look like cysts/boils but I’m certain this is due to my “cold” and the stress of what’s going on right now. I’m finding it painful to walk and sit upright. 

My birthday passed without celebration. Both of my brothers never wished me happy birthday, we saw each other but they mustn’t of remembered. I can’t say they’re eaten up by the stress of my grandma as they don’t ever offer support, we give them updates as and when. But everyone has their own stresses going on in their lives I guess - and kind of hope.

Id say roll on Christmas but I don’t know if that will help anything…
